# AitherZero

> PowerShell 7+ automation framework — numbered, self-describing scripts.

Ops knowledge lives in people's shell history, so the same recovery gets improvised differently every time it is needed.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/AitherZero
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Run one numbered script and read what it says it did.

## Composes with

- [awrecover](https://aitherium.github.io/awrecover/) — Labelled snapshots with an all-or-nothing restore.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/AitherZero
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/AitherZero/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/AitherZero/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-aitherzero.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
